# beam4pm_pro GCE Image Build

Packer template building a Google Compute Engine custom image for
beam4pm_pro: `debian-12` base, Docker installed, the
product container `ghcr.io/seanchatmangpt/beam4pm:latest` pre-pulled, and a systemd unit
(`beam4pm.service`) that runs it on port
8080 at boot.

Both `.pkr.hcl` files here are generated consequences of the consumer RDF
graph (`b4pi:PackerImage` facts) via `ggen sync run` -- edit the graph and
regenerate; never hand-edit these files.

## Build

Requires real GCP credentials (`gcloud auth application-default login`),
the Compute Engine API enabled, and image-create IAM. None of that is
exercised by the manufacturing pipeline -- local validation stops at
`packer validate`.

```bash
packer init  infra/gcp/packer
packer validate infra/gcp/packer
packer build -var "project_id=YOUR_PROJECT" infra/gcp/packer
```
